description: This file declares the external interface for the HTTP Mbo Identity object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions. It provides prototypes for functions implemented in corresponding source files, and is used to expose the API for other components to interact with the Mbo Identity object within an HTTP or BroadWay system.

methods.name: HttpCreateMboIdentity
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new Mbo Identity object, given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: HttpMboIdtCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Http Mbo Identity object with specified contexts.

methods.name: HttpMboIdtRemove
methods.description: Removes/deletes the specified Mbo Identity object instance.

methods.name: HttpMboIdtEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary objects for the Mbo Identity object.

methods.name: HttpMboIdtInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Mbo Identity object, setting up necessary internal state.
